Tools of the mason such as sledgehammer and plumb rule and bob

Tools used by an electrician such as cutting plier and qire strippers and electric drill
Isha with Arul the carpenter who is fixing a cupboard door
Tools of the carpenter such as sander and sandpaper and chisel and nails and screws

Tools of a plumber such as wrench and pipe vice and hacksaw

Tools of painters such as a paint bucket and extension pole and drop cloth
